Pakistan Defeats Sri Lanka in First T20 Match

Pakistan secured a victory over Sri Lanka in the first T20 international match of their three-game series. Sahibzada Farhan was instrumental in leading Pakistan to the win. The match is part of a T20I series scheduled for 2026.
